rule.description: 在 CI 工作流中，E2E 测试步骤的 `continue-on-error` 必须设置为 `false`，确保测试失败时 CI 流水线能够正确报错并阻止合入。临时调试期间可能设置为 `true`，但合入前必须恢复。

antipattern.code:
name: E2E Test

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      vllm_version:
        type: string
        required: true

jobs:
  e2e-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run E2E tests
        continue-on-error: true  # ← 不应忽略 E2E 测试错误
        run: |
          pytest tests/e2e/ -v --timeout=600

pattern.code:
# commit 7a50a64 "revert continue on error" (+1/-1)

name: E2E Test

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      vllm_version:
        type: string
        required: true

jobs:
  e2e-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run E2E tests
        continue-on-error: false  # ← 恢复为 false，确保测试失败时 CI 报错
        run: |
          pytest tests/e2e/ -v --timeout=600

--- a/.github/workflows/_e2e_test.yaml
+++ b/.github/workflows/_e2e_test.yaml
@@ -1,3 +1,5 @@
+# commit 7a50a64 "revert continue on error" (+1/-1)
+
 name: E2E Test
 
 on:
@@ -13,6 +15,6 @@
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v4
       - name: Run E2E tests
-        continue-on-error: true  # ← 不应忽略 E2E 测试错误
+        continue-on-error: false  # ← 恢复为 false，确保测试失败时 CI 报错
         run: |
           pytest tests/e2e/ -v --timeout=600
key_changes: -        continue-on-error: true  # ← 不应忽略 E2E 测试错误
+        continue-on-error: false  # ← 恢复为 false，确保测试失败时 CI 报错
